notes.notes:
Fix: Level selection in "Animate Creations" directed to wrong level nr 29
Fix: White background on startup didn't fill the entire screen on ultrawide displays

notes.title: Small save game issues
notes.notes:
Hello gamers!
There may be some problems with savegames between updates. This issue will be adressed in the full release on the 1st of May. Until then if you feel robbed of the experience you may cosider reseting your progress via the options menu. This will not remove any achievements you've collected. Also it has come to my attention that some achievements may be buggy but rest assured, all of them are gatherable.
Cheers
Creator of memorel
